dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) describes the management of research data generated within the Latvian Council of Science Fundamental and Applied Research Project (LZP FLPP) “Photonic Reservoirs for Intelligent Signal Impairments Mitigation in Coherent Optical Communication Systems (PRISM)” (lzp-2025/1-0309). The plan outlines how research data will be generated, processed, documented, stored, and shared throughout the project lifecycle.
The project can produce several types of research data, including experimental measurements from photonic reservoir computing systems, optical communication signal datasets, numerical simulation data, and machine learning datasets used for signal processing and impairment mitigation. The DMP ensures that research data are managed in accordance with the FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable).
